requirements.title: Current authority recovery
requirements.description: Bind the current project pin, Controller, task, exact objects and selected workset before governed work.
requirements.fullText: Use current repo-local authority and the explicit project pin. Reprove task, actor/role/phase, exact scope, protection and applicable source identities. Recovery grants no action.

requirements.title: Independent action authorization
requirements.description: Every mutating or side-effecting action retains its categorical authorization gate.
requirements.fullText: Require the exact action package and current bindings. Process resolution selects requirements only; it cannot grant, merge, weaken or replace authorization, Review, OWNER_ACCEPT, Git, push, browser, device, external or protection gates.

requirements.title: Task scope closure
requirements.description: Keep objective, exact scope, forbidden boundaries and evidence ceiling current.
requirements.fullText: Before material work bind objective, exact/contingency/forbidden paths, producer and direct consumers, validation and evidence ceiling. Unknown impact does not silently narrow scope.

requirements.title: Critical independent Review
requirements.description: CRITICAL candidates require relationally independent Review where the action contract requires it.
requirements.fullText: Bind the frozen candidate, candidate writer and material contributors. Owner, issuer, writer and contributors cannot masquerade as the independent final Reviewer. Review does not perform OWNER_ACCEPT or authorize implementation/Git.

requirements.title: Owner acceptance remains separate
requirements.description: Product/domain acceptance is distinct from independent Review.
requirements.fullText: The current task owner accepts the reviewed exact result against the user/product decision. Reviewer approval alone is not OWNER_ACCEPT.

requirements.title: Final output completeness
requirements.description: Final delivery states the accepted current result, evidence ceiling, material limitations and unique next action.
requirements.fullText: Before final output compare the actual result and claims with the user request and selected requirements. Missing required work is completed when safe or returned as the exact blocker; MISSING/NOT_DELIVERED is not completion.

requirements.title: Git and push separation
requirements.description: Git stage, commit and remote push remain separate explicit boundaries.
requirements.fullText: Reprove index, exact candidate and authorization independently for stage, commit and push. A stable local release does not imply publication or project adoption.

requirements.title: External side effects remain separate
requirements.description: Browser, device and external actions require their own current gates.
requirements.fullText: Confirm the exact side effect, credential/target, user decision and evidence ceiling. Framework process resolution is not host enforcement and does not grant the external capability.

requirements.title: Protected boundary
requirements.description: Protected or excluded paths fail closed and are not accessed by fallback.
requirements.fullText: Honor current protected read/hash/diff/index/write boundaries. UNKNOWN or an unavailable bounded helper returns an exact blocker and never triggers broad search or fallback access.

requirements.title: Proportional architecture
requirements.description: Machinery-rich architecture recommendations require one compact proportionality conclusion.
requirements.fullText: Record existing sufficiency, classification, minimum sufficient fix, added machinery and escalation trigger before recommending new roles, states, services, tasks or transitions. Routine fixes that add no machinery are exempt.
